sections.title: Welcome to Control & Coordination
learning_goals: Understand the importance of control and coordination in living organisms.
Get an overview of the nervous and endocrine systems.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Standard introductory section with avatar-led narration.

sections.title: What You'll Learn
learning_goals: How organisms respond to stimuli.
The structure and function of the nervous system, including neurons and reflex actions.
The components and roles of the human brain.
Plant coordination through hormones.
The animal endocrine system and its major hormones.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Standard summary section with avatar and bullet points of learning objectives.

sections.title: Introduction to Control & The Nervous System
learning_goals: Define control and coordination and their necessity.
Explain the role of stimuli in biological responses.
Describe the basic structure and function of a neuron.
Understand how nerve impulses are transmitted.
Differentiate between voluntary and involuntary actions.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Visualizing neurons and nerve impulse transmission is best done with animated video for clarity and engagement in biology.

sections.title: Reflex Actions and the Reflex Arc
learning_goals: Define reflex action and its importance.
Trace the pathway of a reflex arc.
Identify the components of a reflex arc (receptor, effector, spinal cord).
sections.renderer_reasoning: Animating the reflex arc pathway will significantly aid understanding of this biological process.

sections.title: The Human Brain: Structure and Functions
learning_goals: Identify the main divisions of the human brain (fore-brain, mid-brain, hind-brain).
Describe the functions of key brain parts like the cerebrum, cerebellum, medulla, and pons.
Understand the roles of the Central and Peripheral Nervous Systems.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Visualizing the complex structure of the human brain and its various parts is best achieved with a detailed video animation.

sections.title: Coordination and Hormones in Plants
learning_goals: Explain how plants coordinate their growth and responses.
Identify major plant hormones (auxin, gibberellin, cytokinin, abscisic acid).
Describe the functions of each plant hormone.
Understand tropic movements in plants.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Concepts are primarily definitional and descriptive, suitable for text and bullet points with avatar narration.

sections.title: Animal Endocrine System: Major Glands
learning_goals: Define hormones and their role in animal coordination.
Identify key endocrine glands (hypothalamus, pituitary, thyroid, adrenal).
Describe the functions of hormones like adrenaline and growth hormone.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Focuses on definitions and functions of glands and hormones, suitable for text-based presentation with avatar.

sections.title: Hormones for Metabolism and Reproduction
learning_goals: Understand the role of the pancreas in blood sugar regulation (insulin, glucagon).
Identify reproductive hormones (testosterone, estrogen, progesterone) and their functions.
Explain the concept of feedback mechanisms in hormone regulation.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Primarily conceptual and descriptive, suitable for text and bullet points with avatar narration.

sections.title: Test Your Knowledge!
learning_goals: Reinforce understanding of control and coordination concepts.
Apply knowledge to answer specific questions about the nervous and endocrine systems.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Standard quiz format with questions and answers displayed as flashcards.

sections.title: Key Takeaways: Flashcard Review
learning_goals: Review essential definitions and concepts related to control and coordination.
Consolidate understanding of the nervous system, brain, and hormones.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Flashcard-style review is best presented with text and avatar narration.

learning_goals: Summarize the main topics covered in the video.
